title: Annotated article
blurb: Six text effects on one article, all cut from the article's own picture: ruby that shows near the pointer, the quote drawn again large behind the column, a selection that glows, a heading whose glyphs fly in, footnotes that slide out beside the line, and strike-through drawn by a pen.
question: Can one 2D canvas make six text effects (ruby, pull quote, selection glow, kinetic heading, footnotes, strike-through) from one article's picture, with no change to the article's markup?
result: Yes. Clip paths and source rectangles of one drawElementImage() picture give all six. ctx.filter applies to the picture, so a colour matrix can pick out the selection colour with no readback.
